content.title: Where is Braylon Mullins from and how old is he? Everything to know about UConn's hero
content.text: The UConn Huskies have a new rising star, and his name is already generating buzz across the country: Braylon Mullins. With just one season in the NCAA, the young guard has gone from promising recruit to key contributor, especially after his impact in March.To watch this video, agree to share video information with third partiesAgree|More infoWhere is Braylon Mullins from?Braylon Mullins is from Greenfield, Indiana, a small city that played a key role in his development as a player.He attended Greenfield-Central High School, where he quickly became one of the top players in the state. During his senior season, he put up remarkable numbers-over 32 points per game-while also contributing rebounds, assists, and steals.His dominance earned him two of the most prestigious honors in high school basketball: he was named a McDonald's All-American in 2025 and won Indiana Mr. Basketball.How old is Braylon Mullins?Braylon Mullins was born in April 2006, making him 19 years old during the 2025-26 college basketball season.That makes him one of the youngest and most promising talents in college basketball, with significant room to grow both physically and technically.From prospect to standout at UConnMullins arrived at UConn as a five-star recruit and a consensus top-25 prospect, choosing the Huskies over programs like Indiana and North Carolina.In his freshman season, the 6-foot-6 guard has averaged around 12 points per game, establishing himself as a key piece in a deep and talented roster led by Dan Hurley.His impact goes beyond the stat sheet. During the NCAA Tournament, Mullins delivered clutch performances, including a standout showing against UCLA that helped push UConn deeper into the bracket.Player profile and styleAt 6-foot-6 with strong perimeter shooting ability, Mullins stands out primarily as a scorer. His quick release, off-ball movement, and ability to hit big shots make him a perfect fit for the modern game.He also comes from a basketball background, as the son of former college player Josh Mullins, which helps explain his high basketball IQ and polished skill set.A bright future aheadAt just 19 years old, Braylon Mullins is already appearing in projections for the 2026 NBA Draft as a potential first-round pick.His blend of youth, talent, and performance on big stages makes him one of the most exciting names to watch in college basketball. And while his journey is just beginning, all signs point to a future at the professional level.
